caption: The drawing depicts a vintage wooden clamp-like object composed of two red, dome-shaped padded cushions at the top, trimmed at the edge with a green zigzag pattern. These cushions are each supported by a turned wooden post, both of which are attached to a horizontal wooden bar. The bar is connected at its center to a vertical arrangement of wooden and metal components below. In the middle, there is another small turned post supporting a second, shorter horizontal wooden bar, which in turn supports a third, smaller turned post and another short wooden bar. At the bottom, the device features a large metal screw mechanism for tightening, ending in two round knobs. The background of the drawing is a plain light beige color, and the artist's signature, "Oscar Bluhme," is located at the bottom right.
title: Twin Sewing Bird
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
